description: agent-notes/claude-code/Claude-Code-Integration.md specifies the Claude Code hook contracts implemented in tether/claude_code/hooks.py, with literal output samples: SessionStart adaptive-density output (silent / all-HEALTHY one-liner / markdown), the Stop block contract (decision=block plus a markdown reason), and the PreToolUse Read-only short-circuit emitting hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext as a RefsReport (rename candidates not emitted at PreRead). Changes to any hook's trigger or output shape in hooks.py must update the corresponding section of the doc.
